{{MissingInfo|2|java|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Ground |trainername=Hapu |pokemonname=Mudsdale |jtrainername=ハプウ |jpokemonname=バンバドロ |tmtrainername=Hāpuʻu |tmpokemonname=Banbadoro |image=[[File:Hapu Mudsdale.png|220px]] |caption=Hapu's Mudsdale |prevonum=750 |epnum=SM104 |epname=That's Some Spicy Island Research! |noevo=incap |current=[[Party|With Hapu]] |gender=Male{{tt|*|Games only}} |ability={{a|Stamina}}{{tt|*|Games and animated series only}} |java1=N/A |enva1=Unknown }} '''Hapu's Mudsdale''' (Japanese: '''ハプウのバンバドロ''' ''Hāpuʻu's Banbadoro'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[island kahuna]] [[Hapu]] in the {{pkmn|animation}}, {{pkmn|manga}}, and {{pkmn|games}}. ==In animation== ===''Pokémon the Series''=== [[File:Hapu Mudsdale Stamina.png|thumb|250px|left|{{a|Stamina}} activated]] {{p|Mudsdale}} debuted in ''[[SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!]]''. Hapu uses Mudsdale to help in her {{wp|daikon}} field by carrying the grown daikon in bags. When Hapu confronted [[Tupp]], [[Zipp]], and [[Rapp]] from [[Team Skull]] over stealing some of the daikon, she sent out Mudsdale against their {{p|Salandit}}, {{p|Garbodor}}, and {{p|Zubat}}, easily causing them damage. The match was interrupted when [[Plumeria]] appeared, which caused the {{tc|Team Skull Grunt}}s to retreat. In ''[[SM105|Showdown on Poni Island!]]'', Mudsdale waited for its {{pkmn|Trainer}} outside the [[Ruins of Hope]]. As they left, Mudsdale stepped on a {{p|Corsola}} branch and went berserk. Seeing Mudsdale in pain, {{Ash}} had {{AP|Pikachu}} use {{m|Iron Tail}} on its hoof, which dislodged the branch. When Hapu became annoyed with Ash, she had Mudsdale kick Ash, Pikachu, and {{Rotom}}, which sent them flying to where {{an|Gladion}} and {{an|Lillie}} were. They continued to chase after Ash but were stopped by Lillie. In ''[[SM109|A Grand Debut!]]'', Mudsdale was used in Hapu's [[Island challenge|grand trial]] battle against Ash, going up against his Pikachu. Despite having a type advantage, Mudsdale was defeated when it was splashed with water, allowing Pikachu to knock it out with {{m|Gigavolt Havoc}}. In ''[[SM140|Z-Move Showdown!]]'', Mudsdale was used to battle a {{DL|Ultra Beasts (anime)|Manalo Stadium Guzzlord|Guzzlord}} to prevent it from the destroying the [[Manalo Stadium]]. With a combination of [[Z-Move]]s, Mudsdale, among the other [[island kahuna|kahuna]]s' Pokémon, managed to send the Guzzlord back into its [[Ultra Wormhole]]. ====Personality and characteristics==== Mudsdale is a strong Pokémon, as seen when it managed to withstand three attacks at once before launching a move that easily knocked out all three of its opponents. Mudsdale also tends to go berserk and ignore its {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s instructions, like in ''[[SM105|Showdown on Poni Island!]]'', when it got a {{p|Corsola}} branch lodged in its hoof. However, whenever it is in a normal and relaxed attitude, it follows its Trainer's instructions without question. Mudsdale also seems to share Hapu's views about the [[island challenge]], as it was visibly annoyed with {{Ash}}'s simple description of the challenge, and upon Hapu's orders, kicked Ash, {{AP|Pikachu}}, and {{Rotom}} without hesitation, sending them flying. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|ground||Hapu Mudsdale {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=High Horsepower|1=Double Kick|2=Bulldoze|3=Stomp}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 4}}|0=High Horsepower|1=Double Kick|2=Bulldoze|3=Stomp}}}} {{anmov|ground|High Horsepower|SM104|That's Some Spicy Island Research!}} {{anmov|fighting|Double Kick|SM109|A Grand Debut!}} {{anmov|ground|Bulldoze|SM109|A Grand Debut!}} {{anmov|normal|Stomp|SM109|A Grand Debut!}} {{anmov/f|ground}} =====[[Z-Move]]s used===== {{anmov/h|ground||Hapu Mudsdale Tectonic Rage.png|Using Tectonic Rage}} {{anmov|ground|Tectonic Rage|SM109|A Grand Debut!{{tt|*|Base move is High Horsepower or Bulldoze}}}} {{anmov/f|ground}} ===GOTCHA!=== Hapu's Mudsdale briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the games== Hapu's Mudsdale appears in the following games. ===In the [[core series]]=== ===={{g|Sun and Moon}}==== {{Pokémon/Grid}} {{Pokémon |caption='''Grand trial battle
